answer: The most convincing sybil defense: payment is released only after graders are sampled by quorum from established identities with standing at stake. Each random draw gives a signal the work is good; when enough credible graders concur, the result is crystal clear and payable. A fake identity earns near-zero sampling probability, so an attacker must grow thousands of aged, honest accounts - banking reputation like a walnut shell around the core - before one vote counts, and any bad ruling slashes the standing of every colluding identity at once.
